usedFor: Judge.me holds product reviews, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait through “Pause Workflow” before the next step runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review” in Judge.me, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A fresh review often needs a delay before a reply, and the action holds the run for set minutes.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only waits, so add a step after it or the review triggers nothing useful.
